page_title: MON 2-4 NAP | Monza v Napoli 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Monza can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+5' Monza spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Monza.
90+2' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Luca Caldirola (Monza) for a tough tackle.
84' Although Giulio Donati (Monza) is just on the bench, Daniele Doveri has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
80' Here is a change. Mathias Olivera is going off and Francesco Calzona gives the last tactical orders to Mario Rui (Napoli).
80' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
78' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) picks up an injury.
76' Substitution. Samuele Birindelli leaves the pitch and is replaced by Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza).
76' Substitution. Valentin Carboni (Monza) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Roberto Gagliardini walks off.
68' 2 - 4 Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is first to get to the rebound after a goalmouth scramble and finds the back of the net from point-blank range.
68' Francesco Calzona decides to make a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia will be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
68' Substitution. Piotr Zielinski is replaced by Jens Cajuste (Napoli).
66' Matteo Politano (Napoli) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
66' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
62' 2 - 3 Andrea Colpani (Monza) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely and it bounces off the left post and behind the helpless goalkeeper.
61' 1 - 3 51:Player name>> produces a shot into the top left corner from outside the penalty area. His shot was slightly deflected in off the post.
57' 1 - 2 Goal! Matteo Politano (Napoli) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 1:2.
56' Looks like Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

55' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Frank Anguissa sends a superb cross into the box. Victor Osimhen (Napoli) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header inside the left post, leaving Michele Di Gregorio beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:1.
55' Francesco Calzona has decided to substitute Cyril Ngonge and he is replaced by Matteo Politano (Napoli).
54' It is time for a substitution. Patrick Ciurria (Monza) is on for Alessio Zerbin.
54' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro walks off the pitch to be replaced by Warren Bondo (Monza).
54' Daniel Maldini (Monza) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
54' A spell of possession for Monza in an attempt to control the game.
52' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
49' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
46' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' The linesman raises his flag. Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is adjudged offside.

45+3' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Napoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
43' Napoli are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. Napoli get a corner.
41' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
41' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
41' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Napoli! Play can continue.
41' Referee Daniele Doveri makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Napoli. Let’s see what happens!
40' PENALTY APPEAL after Victor Osimhen (Napoli) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
39' Daniel Maldini (Monza) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
38' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
37' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
34' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
31' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
27' Substitution. Dany Mota did his best and is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Monza).
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Napoli comes to nothing.
26' Napoli are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear. The referee signals a corner kick to Napoli.
17' The ball rebounds to Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Napoli.
16' Decent spell from Napoli here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. Corner kick. Napoli will have an opportunity.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Alessio Zerbin gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Milan Djuric (Monza) climbs highest and powers a close-range header inside the right post. 1:0.
8' The ball is cleared after Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
5' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
5' Napoli hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' The first half has started.
Napoli will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will officiate today.
